name: Anya
source:
The protagonist's niece and a bright, positive and gentle girl that cares about others and knows how to cook.
Her mother had to leave her under the care of her brother because of some overseas business she had to attend.
Since Anya's father is Russian, that makes her half-Russian and half-Japanese.
